name: Scratched Metal 30
notes: A worked metal surface: one merged scratch history, 55% near-linear and 45% deep-swirl strokes with heavy-tailed lengths, widths and depths, gating a solid primary. Dual-gate architecture (docs/fractal-texture-math.md par.9): the mask multiplies the finished stroke once, so its structure survives the paint train; canvas-anchored delivery was considered for the damage textures and rejected in review in favour of dual-gating everything. Tips synthesized and calibrated from tips/scratched-metal.spec.json (levels 30/55/80 = core-band stroke coverage); spectral verification by tools/spectrum-audit.mjs. Light wear: sparse deep gouges and hairlines.
